text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The data collection on fierce rivals that 
Transcend and her Trainer aimed for is 
completed at the Teio Sho. However, 
Transcend was restless and distracted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Getting fired up once more, they headed to 
the paddock, where Smart Falcon was 
showering her fans with smiles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Why can she keep smiling? How can she 
still believe in what lies beyond the 
finish line? In search of answers, 
Transcend heads into the race.
